import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long flow, cap;
        Edge(int from, int to, long flow, long cap) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class DinicMaxFlow {
        int s, t;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] level;
        int[] pos;
        int MAX_NODES;

        DinicMaxFlow(int maxNodes) {
            MAX_NODES = maxNodes;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new List[MAX_NODES];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            level = new int[MAX_NODES];
            pos = new int[MAX_NODES];
        }

        void clear() {
            edges.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, long capacity) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean create_levels() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            level[s] = 0;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.cap > e.flow && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long send_flow(int u, long flow_limit) {
            if (u == t || flow_limit == 0) return flow_limit;
            long pushed = 0;
            for (; pos[u] < adj[u].size(); ++pos[u]) {
                int idx = adj[u].get(pos[u]);
                Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.cap > e.flow) {
                    long delta = send_flow(e.to, Math.min(flow_limit, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (delta > 0) {
                        e.flow += delta;
                        edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= delta;
                        pushed += delta;
                        flow_limit -= delta;
                        if (flow_limit == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long solve() {
            long total = 0;
            while (create_levels()) {
                Arrays.fill(pos, 0);
                long delta;
                while ((delta = send_flow(s, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    total += delta;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] visited_cell = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] distance_map = new int[14][14];
    static int N, T;
    static int[] dest_node = new int[103];

    static void multi_source_bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(distance_map[i], 111);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distance_map[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});

        int[] dr = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dc = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur[0], c = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (visited_cell[r][c]) continue;
            visited_cell[r][c] = true;
            distance_map[r][c] = d;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dr[i], nc = c + dc[i];
                if (nr >= 1 && nr <= N && nc >= 1 && nc <= N &&
                    !visited_cell[nr][nc] && grid1[nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int node_id(int t, int r, int c) {
        return t * N * N + (r - 1) * N + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid1[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid2[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        DinicMaxFlow flow = new DinicMaxFlow(7100);
        flow.s = 0;
        flow.t = 7100 - 2;

        int start_r = 0, start_c = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    start_r = i;
                    start_c = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N * N; ++i) {
            dest_node[i] = 7100 - 3 - (N * N - i);
        }

        multi_source_bfs(start_r, start_c);

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    flow.add_edge(flow.s, node_id(0, i, j), grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2[i][j])) {
                    flow.add_edge(dest_node[node_id(0, i, j)], flow.t, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                flow.add_edge(node_id(0, i, j), dest_node[node_id(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }

        int[] dr = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dc = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                    if (grid1[r][c] == 'Y' || grid1[r][c] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
                        if (nr >= 1 && nr <= N && nc >= 1 && nc <= N &&
                            grid1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && grid1[nr][nc] != 'Z' &&
                            distance_map[r][c] >= t && distance_map[nr][nc] >= t) {
                            flow.add_edge(node_id(t - 1, nr, nc), node_id(t, r, c), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                    flow.add_edge(node_id(t, r, c), dest_node[node_id(0, r, c)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.solve());
    }
}
